--- select_is_distinct_from.sql
SELECT
  1 IS DISTINCT FROM 2 AS distinct_values,
  1 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 2 AS not_distinct_values,
  1 IS DISTINCT FROM NULL AS one_null,
  NULL IS DISTINCT FROM NULL AS both_null,
  NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL AS both_null_not

--- SQL
SELECT 1 IS DISTINCT FROM 2 AS distinct_values, 1 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 2 AS not_distinct_values, 1 IS DISTINCT FROM NULL AS one_null, NULL IS DISTINCT FROM NULL AS both_null, NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL AS both_null_not
